Lesson flow (numbered arrows), all over HTTPS
1
Student signs in; Auth returns a JWT,
kept in the session store.
2
App loads the lesson path and progress via the
REST API; RLS returns only that student's rows.
3
Lesson Engine runs the lesson, then sends the
answers + JWT to the complete-lesson function.
4
Function grades the answers, then in one transaction
writes progress, updates XP/streak, unlocks next lesson.
The app never sends XP or a score, so it can't be faked.
